content.title: Grid Mystery Solved: Researchers Find the Culprit
content.caption: Germany's largest transmission system operator Tennet Germany brought the puzzle to Dirk Witthaut, a researcher at Forschungszentrum Jülich in Germany, to solve the mystery of coordinated power drops.
